provenance: Every answer below was read out of urllib3 2.7.0's own source and is cited to the file and line it came from. None of it came from a specification this engine produced, which is the only way this measures anything: a question set derived from our own extraction would be answered by construction.
shape: A client library, deliberately unlike the AI-MUD fixture. It serves no HTTP routes, persists nothing, and has no application entry point, so a specification tuned to a web service has nothing here to lean on. Its subject matter is retry policy, connection pooling and an exception hierarchy.
